source_pr_title: fix(backup): prepend devenv profile to PATH in backup script
author: coderabbitai
body:
_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Preserve the workspace container's existing `PATH`.**

Line 75 expands `$PATH` in the backup container shell before `oc exec` runs. The workspace container therefore receives the backup image's `PATH`, not its own existing value. This can remove workspace-specific directories and make `tar`, `openssl`, or other required commands unavailable.

Export the path inside the remote `/bin/sh -ec` script so `$PATH` expands in the workspace container.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-    `oc exec -n "\${NAMESPACE}" "\${POD}" -c ${containerName} -- env HOME_MOUNT_PATH="\${HOME_MOUNT_PATH}" BACKUP_KEEP="\${BACKUP_KEEP}" PATH="\${HOME_MOUNT_PATH}/.devenv/profile/bin:$PATH" /bin/sh -ec '`,
+    `oc exec -n "\${NAMESPACE}" "\${POD}" -c ${containerName} -- env HOME_MOUNT_PATH="\${HOME_MOUNT_PATH}" BACKUP_KEEP="\${BACKUP_KEEP}" /bin/sh -ec '`,
+    '  export PATH="$HOME_MOUNT_PATH/.devenv/profile/bin:$PATH"',
```

</details>
